title: Solid, liquid and gas
caption: In a solid the particles are packed in a regular pattern and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are still touching but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move quickly in all directions.
alt: Three boxes: water molecules in a regular grid (solid), close but disordered (liquid), and widely spaced with motion arrows (gas).
description: Solid: particles in fixed, regular positions.
Liquid: particles close together, irregular, sliding past each other.
Gas: particles far apart, moving randomly.
